## v0.5.3 · Actionable Version Maintenance

v0.5.3 makes status-page version maintenance clearer, improves Host execution ownership, and refreshes the documentation shipped with all official packages.

### Changes

- Guide Mnemon CLI installation and migration through `@mnemon-dev/mnemon` on npm. Distinguish missing, unreadable, outdated, current, locally newer, and restart-pending states, while keeping installation guidance available offline.
- Verify npm ownership before updating the active CLI; share discovery with Native execution and support verified Windows npm launchers. Homebrew and Go updates remain available.
- Expand the dsh-mnemon card to maintain Source, Strategy, and Provider packages. Show installed versions, Starter pins, and Profile ownership; update independently installed packages in their owning Profile while preserving Starter dependencies and source links.
- Enforce read-only configuration and existing management authorization, serialize updates, verify installed versions, and retain restart reminders.
- Clarify Host turn/maintenance cleanup and Source presentation ownership, fix compact-header overlap, and refresh bilingual guides and published READMEs.

Implementation: [#190](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/190), [#191](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/191), [#192](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/192).

### Packages and upgrade

The Starter and all sixteen official plugins advance to `0.5.3` because each has changed published content. Independent versioning remains in effect; unchanged packages will not be republished in future releases merely because the Starter changes.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.3
```

Use `headless` for a Headless Profile, then restart DSH. Mnemon CLI remains a separate installation:

```sh
npm install --global @mnemon-dev/mnemon@latest
mnemon --version
```

No storage migration is required. Existing profiles and data remain compatible; rollback uses `dsh-mnemon@0.5.2` in the same Profile. The release workflow verifies frozen artifacts, npm read-back, a clean complete install, and a real Registry upgrade from v0.4.7 before creating this release.

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.3/docs/en/releases/v0.5.3.md), [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.3/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.3.md), and [real status-page evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.3/docs/pr-assets/status-version-maintenance/README.md) for compatibility, validation limits, and screenshots.
